headline: Beat Alpha Grizbo
title: Alpha Grizbo Boss Tips | Water and Grass Win the Fight | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Alpha Grizbo hits hard, but it has a clear weakness. It is a Rock bear, so bring Water and Grass attackers. Its claw swipes come in a row, so back away and dodge. When it turns red and enraged, do not trade hits. Wait it out, because when the rage ends it is tired and its Break resistance drops. That is your window for big damage. Which Alpha is next on your list? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Then it is tired and open

description: Alpha Grizbo boss tips in Aniimo: it is a Rock element boss weak to Water and Grass; dodge its claw swipes, wait out the enraged state, then hit it while its Break resistance is lowered.
